cloak_probe.source:
# Run from the repository root: elixir -pa _build/dev/lib/cloak/ebin tmp/security/pr44-plan/cloak_otp_probe.exs
# Uses an ephemeral key and synthetic values; never reads configured credentials.
key = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
tag = "AES.GCM.V1"
prefix = <<1, byte_size(tag)>> <> tag
opts = [key: key, tag: tag]

for value <- ["", "credential secret", <<0, 255, 1>>] do
  {:ok, encoded} = Cloak.Ciphers.AES.GCM.encrypt(value, opts)
  <<^prefix::binary-size(12), iv::binary-size(16), mac::binary-size(16), body::binary>> = encoded
  ^value = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(:aes_256_gcm, key, iv, body, "AES256GCM", mac, false)
  iv2 = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16)
  {body2, mac2} = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(:aes_256_gcm, key, iv2, value, "AES256GCM", true)
  {:ok, ^value} = Cloak.Ciphers.AES.GCM.decrypt(prefix <> iv2 <> mac2 <> body2, opts)
  bad_mac = :crypto.exor(mac, <<1, 0::size(120)>>)
  :error = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(:aes_256_gcm, key, iv, body, "AES256GCM", bad_mac, false)
end

IO.puts("PASS: configured Cloak format and OTP GCM interoperate both ways; altered authentication tags fail")
